items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) DNP Thu (2nd straight). Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist fracture) on IR/return. If Flowers out, Ravens WR hierarchy: Bateman, Devontez Walker, Wester, Sarratt, Moore.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs for Flowers; Lane surgery/IR
items.opportunity: Bateman flex/WR3 upside; Andrews target bump

items.text: Nico Collins hurt hamstring in Wed practice; Grade 1 strain per reports, DNP Thu, status in jeopardy for Sun vs CIN despite not serious. History of missing 5 games on hammy in 2024. W1 routes: Collins 37/42 dropbacks.
items.why: Hamstring strain Grade 1 + practice absence + prior history

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE vs IND: W1 24% tgt share (tied lead), 21/24 RB touches thru 3Q, 74% snaps, 40% routes targeted. Indy allowed 163 yds/3 TD to Henry. RB1 overall in range of outcomes.
Ashton Jeanty LOVE @ LAC: W1 Utilization 99 (tied Bijan lead). 19% tgt share last 10; 25+ touches 3 of last 4.
items.why: Elite util + volume history post-injury scare overreaction

items.text: A.J. Brown placed on IR with high-ankle sprain; expected miss ~4-6 weeks, earliest Week 6.
Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) full participant Wed/Thu practices; 'I'm ready to go.'
W2 Waiver injury beneficiaries: Ladd McConkey=Tre Harris; Ja'Kobi Lane=Bateman/Moore; De'Zhaun Stribling=Deebo/Robinson; Alvin Kamara=Kendre Miller; A.J. Brown=Doubs/Douglas. Also Sadiq stash.
Bucky Irving LOVE vs CLE: Career-high 26% tgt share W1, 8 more routes than Gainwell, all RB RZ touches. CLE allowed 121 rush/4.8 YPC.
items.why: Pass-game/RZ dominance vs soft run D

items.text: Justin Jefferson LOVE @ CHI: 37% tgt share from Wentz W1; 93 yds/18 PPG career avg with Wentz. CHI allowed 10+ YPT to CAR WRs.
DeVonta Smith LOVE @ TEN: 27% tgt, 13.7 aDOT, 3 deep looks W1. TEN allowed 85% catch/16 YPR to NYJ.
items.why: Volume + deep role vs weak pass D

items.text: Travis Etienne HATE @ BAL: Matched Miller rushes W1, 69% pts via air. Kamara expected back squeezes role; underdog script bad for rushes.
items.conflict: ETR ROS still high on Etienne

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr. HATE vs SEA: 8% tgt share W1 (5th on team), 0 RZ. SEA 3rd-fewest PPG to WRs since last yr. Bourne debut competition.
Dalton Kincaid LOVE vs DET: 69% routes (career high last yr), 77% snaps highest since 2024 W9. DET allowed 27 to TEs W1. Efficient per target.
items.why: Expanded role post-health + soft TE matchup

items.text: Kenyon Sadiq (16th pick) W1: 28 snaps despite limited practice (hernia/setbacks). Schemed goal-line carry + screen + 2 other tgts. Clear intent to involve.
